title: Elodie and the Smile
author: Noor Joubert
blurb: Marguerite Brightwater, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
